description: Defines the google_breakpad::MemoryMappedFile class, which provides functionality to map a file into memory for read-only access, including methods for mapping, unmapping, and accessing the mapped content.

classes.name: MemoryMappedFile
classes.description: A utility class for mapping a file into memory for read-only access, managing system calls for open, close, mmap, and munmap.

methods.name: MemoryMappedFile(const char* path, size_t offset)
methods.description: Constructor that maps a specified file into memory at a given offset.

methods.name: ~MemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Destructor that unmaps the file if mapped.

methods.name: bool Map(const char* path, size_t offset)
methods.description: Maps a file into memory; returns true on success.

methods.name: const MemoryRange& content() const
methods.description: Returns the MemoryRange covering the mapped file.

methods.name: const void* data() const
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the mapped memory.

methods.name: size_t size() const
methods.description: Returns the size of the mapped file in bytes.
